metadata.dcterms:title: Index for a Model of 3d-3d Correspondence for Plumbed 3-Manifolds
metadata.dcterms:creator: Chung, Hee-Joong
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We consider the S2 ×q S1 supersymmetric index of a 3d N = 2 theory T[M3] when M3 is a plumbed 3-manifold. We engineer an eﬀective description of T[M3] from the expression of the homological block for plumbed 3-manifolds as a D2 ×q S1 partition function of a 3d N = 2 theory T[M3] with a boundary condition. We check that the supersymmetric index for such a T[M3] is invariant under the 3d Kirby moves. arXiv:1912.13486v2 [hep-th] 22 Mar 2021
